description: Defines the IFirmwareDownload interface and related structures for firmware download management, including notifications, status retrieval, and failure reasons within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload
classes.description: Interface for managing firmware downloads, including status, notifications, and failure reasons.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload::FirmwareDownloadPercent
classes.description: Structure representing the current firmware download percentage.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload::FirmwareDownloadState
classes.description: Structure representing the current state of the firmware download process.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload::DownloadFailureReason
classes.description: Structure representing the reason for a firmware download failure.

classes.name: IFirmwareDownload::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for firmware download events, such as availability of new firmware.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for firmware download events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current and downloaded firmware versions, location, and reboot status.

methods.name: GetFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Gets the current firmware download progress percentage.

methods.name: SearchFirmware
methods.description: Initiates a search for available firmware updates on the remote server.

methods.name: GetDownloadState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the firmware download process.

methods.name: GetDownloadFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for the last firmware download failure.
